result.title: Towards High-Fidelity Learned Video Compression
result.summary: Professional video workflows operate at qualities that learned video codecs do not reach. We measure how much of a professional quality range a codec covers, from the lowest quality of the standard test conditions, VVC at QP 37, to the highest 4:2:2 grade of the production codec ProRes. To compare inter-frame coding alone, every codec receives original frames as references at the intra positions. On 10-bit YCbCr 4:2:2 test sequences, four recent learned codecs cover 24 to 38% of this range. Their encoders are feed-forward networks with a fixed latent capacity, the number of latent values per sample, of at most 0.25, and removing their quantization raises the quality by at most 1 dB. We propose a learned inter-frame codec whose encoder searches, as the encoders of conventional codecs do. It searches block motion, which a learned network refines, and it searches among learned block transforms whose latent capacity ranges up to 1, selecting the partition, the skip decisions, and the quantized coefficients by a rate-distortion cost. Our codec reaches the upper end of the range on all six sequences. With all residual blocks fixed to 16x16, whose latent capacity is 0.25, the same codec covers 55% of the range, with or without quantization.

AI.brief_summary: 研究学习式视频压缩在高保真区间的覆盖能力，提出编码器结合块运动搜索与学习块变换搜索（含分区、skip 决策与量化系数率失真选择）的帧间编解码器。
AI.relevance_reason: 其关于固定 latent 容量限制质量、以及通过搜索选择 latent 分区与量化系数的分析，可能为 LVR 中的 latent 容量分配与证据筛选提供借鉴线索，需核查。
